{{Quote|I'm from Imperial Intelligence's Experimental Weapons Division. Supposed to trick hapless fools into testing a new weapon.|Geris Paelid|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Experimental Weapons Division''' was a branch in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. One of its members, [[Geris Paelid]], was tasked with testing an experimental weapon on unsuspecting locals on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
